purpose: Teach: 宗派/聖霊/自明/恒久/不平等/伝導/消失/垣間見

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、宗派対立絡みの事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling this case involving the sectarian conflict, then?
lines.style: Measured, genuinely curious. Leans into the question with quiet interest. Soft rise at the end—seeking confirmation, not challenging. The careful precision of someone thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、聖霊を装った詐欺事件にも対応します
lines.en: The police also respond to fraud cases where people impersonate spiritual authority.
lines.style: Professional but not distant. Clear, grounded tone. Straightforward delivery—laying out fact without ceremony. Brief pause after each clause, like checking understanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、自明な証拠を、警察、確実に保全されますね
lines.en: And the police will be carefully preserving the clear evidence in this case, correct?
lines.style: Quiet precision. Each word placed with intention. Slight emphasis on 'clearly' and 'preserve'—anxious about procedure but not accusatory. Trailing upward lilt asking for assurance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、恒久対策として防犯カメラを設置します
lines.en: As a long-term measure, the police will be installing security cameras.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Speaking as someone explaining a decision already made. No defensiveness—just stating what will happen next. Steady, almost reassuring tempo.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不平等な処遇問題を、警察、内部監査されますね
lines.en: And the police will be conducting internal audits on this unequal treatment issue, won't they?
lines.style: Softer now, almost tentative. Still precise, but with an undercurrent of concern. The question of someone who has learned to ask carefully about sensitive things. Gentle downward close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、薬物伝導経路の捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police are also investigating the drug distribution network involved.
lines.style: Collaborative shift in tone. Less procedure-reciting, more engaged. Acknowledges the broader scope without stepping back. Steady, inclusive pace—we're working through this together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の消失事件を、警察、追っておられますね
lines.en: So the police are actively pursuing the suspect who disappeared, then?
lines.style: Slight urgency underneath the composed surface. The word 'actively' carries weight. Still respectful, but with a thread of worry. Leans forward slightly in phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の心の闇を垣間見える供述に注目します
lines.en: The police are paying close attention to the suspect's statements—there's a glimpse of something darker beneath the surface.
lines.style: Intimate, perceptive. Lower register, slower pace. The tone of someone who has read people long enough to trust his instinct. Weight on 'glimpse' and 'darker'—not accusatory, but seeing.
